chunks: The day the trumpet is blown, you will come in hordes;

key_terms.أَفْوَاجًا: In hordes or large groups, indicating a mass gathering
key_terms.الصُّور: The trumpet blown by the angel Israfil to signal the Day of Resurrection

ai.seo_question: What happens when the trumpet is blown on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Isra (17:98) highlights the suddenness and universality of the Resurrection, where humanity emerges in distinct 'afwaj' (crowds or groups) based on their spiritual states. It underscores the divine justice that gathers all creation simultaneously, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the tangible reality of the Hereafter as a direct consequence of worldly deeds.
